purpose: Compare every canonical capability against O*NET occupational requirements, professional-quality expectations, leading open-source implementations, public benchmarks, and DreamCo's own advancement targets.

comparison_lanes.name: O*NET capability lane
comparison_lanes.role: Translate occupations into knowledge, skills, abilities, work activities, tasks, tools, and work context.
comparison_lanes.note: O*NET is an occupational reference and does not itself define AI mastery.

comparison_lanes.name: Professional-quality lane
comparison_lanes.role: Measure whether outputs meet practical professional standards for the target occupation or industry.

comparison_lanes.name: Open-source state-of-art lane
comparison_lanes.role: Compare against reproducible, appropriately licensed open implementations and public evaluations.

comparison_lanes.name: Frontier/reference lane
comparison_lanes.role: Compare against current leading systems when reproducible testing is possible.
comparison_lanes.note: Reference comparisons must record model/version/date/settings and must not imply universal superiority from one test.

comparison_lanes.name: DreamCo advancement lane
comparison_lanes.role: Measure DreamCo's own harder tests and research goals after matching existing capability.

path_generation.rule: Never claim mastery from source exposure alone; require executable evidence and benchmark results.

advancement_rule: Once Buddy reaches parity on a defined capability, create a harder DreamCo benchmark and attempt measurable improvement in quality, reliability, controllability, efficiency, accessibility, or cost.
benchmark_integrity: Keep external benchmark scores separate from DreamCo scores.
Use holdout and transfer tests to detect overfitting.
Track benchmark version and dataset version.
Do not copy protected implementation code merely to reproduce a benchmark.
Respect licenses, attribution, terms, and dataset restrictions.
